== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Blizzard Scout 1, 2013 edition, for [[Blizzard Scout 1 (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].

Source: [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf DecipherErrata.pdf] (“Official text as of January 1, 2013”, PDF made 16 April 2013), page 15; archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf 20160809094140] (9 August 2016). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of that page (pdftoppm -r 300).
